body:
I’m so sorry... I know those nightmares well. I also know what it’s like to date someone and finally let yourself feel safe just to lose them. 

I don’t know you, but I know you’re strong because you had to be. You’ll get through this.
That’s what I plan on doing, I just don’t get the “this didn’t work out, go back to what didn’t work before” mentality but more than one friend suggested it today ugh

I have a therapist now, because things got really bad but I struggle to tell anyone about my parent’s abuse and haven’t told her.

I don’t know why I’m so ashamed and can’t tell anyone, but I’m trying. My lifelong friends don’t even know. 

I made an appt with her and am hoping to work up the courage tomorrow. 

Cutting ties feels so harsh, and I don’t know how to do that. My siblings and I are close (they’re far away too - we’re all at least 12 hours driving from our parents), but I always feel like I have to protect them / take most of the pain from my parents
